name: Orbbec SDK v2
summary: Orbbec SDK v2 is a cross-platform library for acquiring and processing data from supported Orbbec RGB-D cameras. It provides device control, stream access and integration wrappers for ROS and ROS 2. The v2 generation opens the core SDK source and supports current Orbbec camera and LiDAR products, with a bundled Viewer for inspection and development.

sources.title: Orbbec Open Sources SDK & Wrapper APIs
sources.quote: Orbbec will officially release the open-source Orbbec SDK and its various wrapper APIs on GitHub by September 30, 2024. Developers will have the freedom to download, use, and modify these codes.
